purpose: Stage externally discovered literature before bibliographic and technical verification.

verification_policy.bibliographic: Verify title, authors, year, venue and DOI against publisher or authoritative bibliographic source.
verification_policy.final_registry: Only verified sources may be promoted into literature_evidence_registry.
verification_policy.standards: Secondary papers cannot establish normative 3GPP or O-RAN requirements.
verification_policy.technical: Verify that the paper actually supports the manuscript claim assigned to it.
